residual_risks: The re-declared USD_DENOMINATED_FORBIDDEN_FIELDS in src/robinhood_lp/research/dataset.py differs from src/robinhood_lp/features/quote.py: T100 omits 'risk_usdg' and 'pnl_usdg', substitutes 'fee_usdg' with 'fees_usdg', and adds 'pnl_usd'. The suffix check ('_usdg' / '_usd') in assert_no_usd_fields still rejects every T053 entry, so RELATIVE_ONLY enforcement is functionally equivalent; the developer's comment claims byte-for-byte identity of the string values, which holds for the enums (NumeraireLevel, ConfidenceLevel) but not for the forbidden-fields list. Future T053 amendments must update this mirror in lockstep, as the developer notes in attempt-001-developer.json.

The in-memory DatasetRegistry is fail-closed: rejected declarations raise and are never stored, so DatasetRegistryQuery.include_rejected has no observable effect on this implementation. The flag is preserved on the query surface for the T101 long-lived store. A test asserts the no-op behaviour; there is no positive test for include_rejected returning rejected snapshots because no such snapshots exist in this implementation.

The 'stablecoin_pair_depegged' reason code is declared in RELATIVE_ONLY_REJECTED_REASONS but validate_numeraire_route never returns it (depeg detection lives in the T053 quote layer / DEFAULT_DEPEG_THRESHOLD_Q64_64). The contract's acceptance clause names 'stablecoin whose qualification has expired', not depegging, so this is consistent with the contract; the depeg reason code is reserved vocabulary only.
